_comment: Generated by scripts/check-openapi.js. These lists may only SHRINK. Each entry is a route that openapi.json does not describe, or a documented operation that falls short of the quality rules. Run `npm run lint:openapi -- --update` after documenting one, and the ratchet clicks: the lower number can never be exceeded again.

excluded.GET /: Browser entry point. Returns a TemplateResponse — the app shell, not an API resource.
excluded.GET /page/{id}: Browser route serving the app shell for a page. The REST equivalent is GET /api/pages/{id}.
excluded.GET /p/{uniqueId}: Browser deep-link, same shell. REST equivalent is GET /api/pages/{id}.
excluded.GET /api/lms/callback: OAuth redirect target. Returns an HTML page that postMessages the opener; it is not callable by an API client and carries no JSON contract.
